title: [29.x][Expense Agent] Confirm before closing Expense User Card without Employee No.
summary: The Expense User card now prompts for confirmation before closing when the mandatory Employee No. field is left blank, preventing unintentional creation of unlinked expense users.
key_points: Added OnQueryClosePage trigger to page 6949 to intercept close actions
User receives confirmation dialog when Employee No. is blank before the card closes
Prevents silent saving of expense users without being linked to an employee
Test cases updated to handle the new confirmation dialog with appropriate handlers
quote: Employee No. is blank. The expense user will not be linked to an employee. Are you sure you want to exit?
